queue.title: Your queue
queue.subtitle: You see only what each patient chose to share. Priority cases come first.
queue.keyboardHint: Use the up and down arrow keys to move through the queue, and Enter to open a request.
queue.emptyAll: Your queue is clear. New requests appear here as they arrive.
queue.chooseRequest: Choose a request to see what the patient shared.
queue.chooseRequestHint: Opening a request is logged and visible to the patient.
queue.loadError: This request couldn't be opened. A colleague may have picked it up.

card.flagged: Flagged result. Details stay hidden until the patient shares them.

patientAsked.after_options: Asked to speak to a person after reading about options.
patientAsked.other: Asked to speak to a person.

topics.pregnancy: currently pregnant, asking about the baby's risk
topics.x_linked_or_dominant: an X-linked or dominant condition in the family
topics.major_decision: wants to talk through a major decision
topics.outside_library: a question outside the content library
topics.asked_for_person: asked to talk to a person

detail.noResult: Shared, but no result is connected to the account yet.
detail.familyShared: Shared by {name}. The family map viewer arrives with the family map screen.

logged.couple: Your access is logged and visible to both patients.
logged.single: Your access is logged and visible to the patient.

detail.requestAccessTitle: Ask to see what isn't shared yet
detail.requestAccessBody: The patient gets an in-app notification and chooses whether to share. Nothing changes until they do.

note.label: Session note
note.placeholder: Private to you and your facility
note.micDenied: Microphone access is blocked. You can still type your notes.
note.micFailed: Couldn't hear that. Try again or type your notes.

actions.label: Actions
actions.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
actions.sessionStarted: Session started. The video room opened in a new tab.
actions.confirmatoryDone: Confirmatory test ordered. The patient's care journey is updated.

specialist.title: Refer to a specialist service
specialist.body: The referral appears in the patient's care journey straight away.
specialist.created: Referral created. The patient's care journey is updated.

close.title: Close this request
close.body: Record what happened. Only the category is stored, never anything about personal or family decisions.
close.required: Choose an outcome to close the request.

sessions.title: Today's sessions
sessions.subtitle: Today's bookings in time order. Times are in Abu Dhabi time.

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: Patients you've seen, with their latest request.
patients.searchHint: Only couples who shared their names can be found by name.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.subtitle: Referrals you created. Changing a status updates the patient's care journey.
referrals.empty: You haven't created any referrals yet.

notes.title: Session notes
notes.subtitle: Your notes, newest first. Private to you and your facility; patients never see them.
notes.unknownRequest: Request no longer in your queue

video.title: Video session (demo)
video.body: This is a placeholder room for the demo. The real video provider connects here.

brief.title: Session brief
brief.subtitle: Points to prepare, written from only what was shared with you. Preparing it is recorded in the patient's access log.
brief.sourceAi: Prepared with AI at {time} from what was shared with you. Check it against the details below.
brief.sourceRules: Prepared at {time} from what was shared with you. Check it against the details below.
brief.error: Couldn't prepare the brief. Try again.
brief.rateLimited: You've prepared a lot of briefs and summaries this hour. Try again later.

rules.flagged: {name}'s result is flagged. Review the original report: GeneBridge doesn't explain flagged results or show numbers for them.
rules.understanding: {name} answered {count} of {total} understanding questions correctly. Some parts may need more explaining.
rules.understandingAll: {name} answered every understanding question correctly. Ask what they'd still like to know.
rules.questions: {name} sent {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}, listed below in their own words.
rules.valuesDiffer: The couple see these differently: {topics}. Worth exploring without steering either way.
rules.sharedSummary: {name} shared an Ask GeneBridge summary, shown below.
rules.nothingShared: Nothing has been shared with you yet. You can ask for access below.

summary.title: Summary for the patient
summary.subtitle: After the session, draft a plain-language summary from your session note, in the patient's language. Edit it, then approve it. Nothing is sent until you approve.
summary.subtitleManual: After the session, write a plain-language summary in the patient's language. Nothing is sent until you approve it. AI drafting isn't set up.
summary.aiNote: Drafted with AI from your notes. Read it closely and change anything that isn't right.
summary.placeholder: Use “Draft from my notes”, or write the summary here.
summary.placeholderManual: Write the summary here, in plain words.

problems.directive: Tells the patient what to do or recommends an option. Describe options as choices.
problems.carrier_not_healthy: Describes a carrier as ill. Carriers are healthy.
problems.diagnosis: Reads like a diagnosis. Check it matches the patient's report.
problems.unverified_number: Gives a chance that isn't in your notes.

summary.confirmChecked: I've checked this wording and it's right for this patient
summary.notSentYet: {name} sees nothing until you approve it.
summary.drafted: Draft ready for {name}. Check it before sending.

errors.rate_limited: You've prepared a lot of briefs and summaries this hour. Try again later.
errors.not_set_up: AI drafting isn't set up. Write the summary yourself.
errors.no_notes: Add a few lines to your session note first: the draft uses only your notes.
errors.failed: Couldn't draft a summary. Try again, or write it yourself.
errors.blocked: Reword the highlighted parts before sending.
errors.needs_confirm: Tick the box to confirm you've checked the highlighted wording.
